content: Stremio/Torrentio-style source pickers: each title surfaces a flat list of stream options labeled by resolution (720p/1080p/4K), file size, and seeder count; users filter by minimum-seeders threshold and sort by quality-then-seeders when no debrid cache is used. Community enhancement (Stremio Enhanced quality-picker plugin) replaces the raw list with grouped visual badges + signal-bar seeder-strength indicators (4 tiers: 500+/200+/50+/1+) and a one-tap 'Best Pick' button, plus per-source provider tags.
